Met today with Rajesh Kumar, the owner of Indocem Engineering Pvt Ltd in Nagpur, who has been
our channel partner for the Maharashtra region for the last three years. He mentioned that they
are currently supplying instrumentation to Ambuja Cement's Nagpur plant, so Ambuja Cement is one
of his end users. Rajesh also said, though only in passing and not confirmed, that a company
called Shree Distributors in Pune might be looking to become a distributor for us as well, but he
wasn't sure and it was just something he heard from a common contact.

I need to follow up with Rajesh in two weeks to check on the Ambuja Cement order status. Also
need to send him the updated price list for our new level sensor model by next week. Should
also remember to ask him for his GST number next time I see him.
